description.value: A 4-site walk-in cluster at Green Lake Park's Sunset View area in the Cariboo, beside a warm, shallow 14 km lake with sandy beaches and roped swimming areas; powerboats dominate the main lake, but the carry-in keeps the immediate sites quieter.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this node as 'Walk-In Campsite' (capacity 4) within Green Lake Park, a BC Parks provincial park in BC's Cariboo region. The linked website confirms the park is active and operational, with camping facilities accessed ~16 km northeast of 70 Mile House. The website covers the entire park rather than this individual node, so most per-site amenity details cannot be confirmed and must remain null; the 'Walk-In' designation in the OSM name is direct positive evidence of vehicle-free, non-motorized access.
concerns: OSM community tag is 'Unknown / Okanagan & Thompson' but Green Lake Park is in the Cariboo region near 70 Mile House, not the Okanagan — community classification likely needs correction.
The generic OSM node name 'Walk-In Campsite' is not uniquely identified on the park website; no per-node amenity details are available, leaving most amenities unverifiable.
No address or phone number present in OSM; BC Parks general reservation line (1-800-689-9025) appears on the website but was absent from the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is an active BC Parks walk-in campsite directly suited to touring cyclists seeking vehicle-free overnight accommodation; the walk-in designation makes it a clear WWC fit for the Camping category.
